items.exampleEn: The police found an important clue.
items.exampleZh: 警方發現了一個重要的線索。

items.exampleEn: The weather prediction was wrong again.
A brainstorm can give you many new ideas.
items.exampleZh: 腦力激盪能帶給你很多新點子。

items.exampleEn: Is that a fact or just your idea?
items.exampleZh: 那是事實，還是你自己的想法？

items.exampleEn: She is considering a new job.
items.exampleZh: 她正在考慮換一份新工作。

items.exampleEn: I have no sense of direction.
The team decided to practice every morning.
items.exampleZh: 球隊決定每天早上練習。

items.exampleEn: It's possible that he missed the bus.

items.sentenceEn: I can't decide what to wear today.
items.sentenceZh: 我決定不了今天要穿什麼。

items.audioEn: My prediction is that it will snow tomorrow.
items.questionZh: 說話的人預測明天會怎樣？

items.sentenceEn: Dogs have a very good sense of smell.
Is it possible to change my seat?

items.stemEn: Before we write the story, let's have a ____ together.
items.stemZh: 在寫故事之前，我們一起來腦力激盪吧。

items.stemEn: Please ____ my idea before you say no.
items.stemZh: 說不之前，請先考慮一下我的想法。

items.passageEn: Our class played a mystery game. First, the teacher gave us a few clues. Before we started, each group made a prediction: "We will find the answer in ten minutes!" Then we had a short brainstorm in small groups: who took the teacher's cake? "Think about the facts," the teacher said. We considered every clue carefully. It took a long time to decide, but our answer made sense. It was the teacher's dog! "Is that possible?" someone asked.
items.passageZh: 我們班玩了一個推理遊戲。老師先給我們幾條線索。開始前，每組都做了一個預測：「我們十分鐘內就會找到答案！」接著我們分小組簡短地腦力激盪：是誰拿走了老師的蛋糕？老師說：「想想事實。」我們仔細考慮每一條線索。花了很久才決定，但我們的答案很合理：是老師的狗！有人問：「這有可能嗎？」

questions.questionZh: 遊戲裡被拿走的是什麼？

referenceEn: This is a fact, not a rumor.
It's a fact, not a rumor.
rubricZh: 「不是…」可寫例如 not a rumor

referenceEn: We haven't decided where to go yet.
We have not decided where to go yet.
rubricZh: 用 decide 表示「決定」，「還沒決定」用現在完成式（例如 haven't decided）
「去哪裡」可寫，例如 where to go、where we will go 等
